summary.text: Donna Mercado Kim represents Senate District 14 in the Hawaii State Senate and has served there since 2000.

paragraphs.text: Kim served on the Honolulu City Council from 1984 to 2000 and was a state Representative from 1982 to 1984.
Kim graduated from Farrington High School, attended the University of Hawaiʻi, and received a B.A. from Washington State University.
